def test_batch_coalesce():
    calls = []
    def f(x):
        calls.append(x)
        return x + 1
    r = RunnableLambda(f).with_coalesce()
    out = r.batch([1, 2, 1, 1, 2])
    check("batch positional order", out == [2, 3, 2, 2, 3])
    check("batch coalesces", len(calls) == 2)
